far.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Soft white and light gray distant futuristic skyline, slender rounded skyscrapers, restrained pastel cyan glass, pale yellow and mint green architectural accents. Light airy atmospheric perspective, handpainted simple shapes and crisp readable silhouette, elegant minimal cel-shaded game art. This is only the far city + sky layer; no near structures. Palette harmonious white-gray-cyan-yellow-mint, bright daylight.
